* Design tokens
The palette (TOK-001…008), status colours (TOK-003), type (TOK-009/010) and the
4px spacing scale (TOK-012) — every colour, font and gutter on this page draws
from these.

* Native constructs
Body copy with *bold*, /italic/, _underline_, +strike+, =verbatim=, ~code~, a
[[https://example.com][link]], sub_{1} and super^{2}, a [50%] cookie, and an
inline timestamp <2026-07-02 Thu>.

* Interactive
Powered by the default runtime =o2h.js= (no framework). The code blocks above
copy on click, the images open in a lightbox, and the carousel gains arrows.
Tabs and a modal, wired by the same runtime:

#+BEGIN_EXPORT html
<div data-o2h="tabs">
  <div role="tablist" aria-label="Demo tabs">
    <button data-tab="a" role="tab" type="button">Overview</button>
    <button data-tab="b" role="tab" type="button">Details</button>
    <button data-tab="c" role="tab" type="button">Specs</button>
  </div>
  <div data-panel="a" role="tabpanel"><p class="org-paragraph">The first panel — click a tab to switch.</p></div>
  <div data-panel="b" role="tabpanel"><p class="org-paragraph">The second panel, revealed by JavaScript.</p></div>
  <div data-panel="c" role="tabpanel"><p class="org-paragraph">The third panel. All keyboard-accessible.</p></div>
</div>
<p><button data-o2h-open="demo-modal" data-component="button" data-variant="primary" type="button">Open modal</button></p>
<div data-o2h="modal" id="demo-modal">
  <div data-component="modal">
    <p class="org-paragraph">A real modal dialog. Click the backdrop or press Esc to close.</p>
    <button data-o2h-close data-component="button" data-variant="outline" type="button">Close</button>
  </div>
</div>
#+END_EXPORT
